$comment: Implementation issues found while documenting every component (WI-0011). They are reported, not silently fixed: each changes shipped CSS or canonical markup and belongs in its own work item. Remove an entry when it is fixed. Rendered into docs/COMPONENT-INVENTORY.md.

issues.issue: Native inputs have no Forma styling for :disabled, :read-only, [aria-invalid] or :user-invalid; author colors also override the browser's disabled look, so a disabled field looks enabled.

Application-layer disabled buttons look enabled apart from losing hover; a.ef-button stays inline so its 44px min-block-size does not apply; primary/destructive variants exist only inside .ef-site; .ef-actions ships only in the marketing stylesheet.
Surfaces have margin: 0 and no anchor positioning fallback, so without CSS anchor positioning they open at the viewport's top-left corner.
summary elements use display: flex, which removes the native disclosure marker; collapsed and expanded look the same.
Spacing is doubled: the foundation gap and the component-layer margin-block-start both apply (32px by default, 24px with data-density=compact).
--ef-cluster-gap is overridden by the component layer's --ef-cluster-space; --ef-switcher-threshold is declared but never used.
Links inside .ef-surface use the primary accent on the secondary surface at about 4.38:1, below 4.5:1.
.ef-section > * + * child rhythm is not scoped to .ef-site, so application pages loading all.css get marketing spacing.
.ef-breakout does not break out of a narrower container; it is min(100%, 90rem) of its parent.
Canonical patterns place <main> inside <section>.
dd keeps the browser's 40px inline-start margin, indenting values even when stacked on phones.
thead is hidden at 30rem and below, which also hides the sort buttons on phones.
Fixed bottom-right placement with physical offsets (not mirrored in RTL) and no stacking; several open notifications overlap. The documentation site contains them per example with contain: layout.
Dismiss button shows "Close" but is named "Dismiss notification" (WCAG 2.5.3 Label in Name).

issues.component: fault-inline, status-lozenge, date-range, rule-builder, question, security-posture
issues.issue: aria-label, aria-labelledby or aria-describedby on an element with no role, which ARIA does not reliably expose.
issues.location: patterns/fault-inline.html, patterns/status-lozenge.html, patterns/date-range.html, patterns/rule-builder.html, patterns/question.html, patterns/security-posture.html

issues.issue: Help text sits inside the wrapping label (becoming part of the accessible name) or is not linked with aria-describedby.
The indicator glyph overlaps long typed text; no padding is reserved for it.
The visually hidden file input gives no visible focus on its label.ef-button; .ef-file-upload__drop is not position: relative.
The selected media card differs only by border and background color (the indicator is removed).
The canonical pattern referenced nonexistent /path/to/*.png images. Fixed in WI-0011 with inline SVG data URIs.

issues.component: alert, feed-item, security-posture, readiness-checklist, best-worst, selection status, range-entry, rule-builder
issues.issue: State attributes used by patterns are not styled: data-tone on alert, data-state="warning"/"danger" on status lozenges, readiness incomplete/warning, data-ef-state on best-worst, selection status and range-entry status, data-ef-operator on rule groups.
white-space: nowrap can overflow at 320px with long labels.
Link targets are about 24–34px tall rather than approximately 44px.
aria-current (page/step) has no visual styling.
The canonical pattern's aria-controls point at panels that do not exist; unselected tabs get no hover or press feedback.
The completed-step check glyph overlaps the step number; the step rail is hard-coded to four columns; the header progress has no accent color.
Hard-coded to seven columns.
Logical inset but physical translate, so the slide direction is wrong in right-to-left pages.
The primary action is indistinguishable in forced colors; the pattern wraps actions in a nav landmark.
The canonical pattern is a non-modal open dialog that shows an Esc hint, but Escape only closes modal dialogs; headings are styled only as h3/h4.
A validation-severity message uses role=status; requirements/CHARACTER-GRID.md says validation and error use role=alert.
The pre is named with aria-labelledby but has no role.
A linked card's stretched ::after covers the card, so a second link or control inside it is unreachable by pointer.
Two near-duplicate utilities (.ef-visually-hidden and .ef-sr-only) with different clipping; neither reveals on focus.
Default figure margin is not reset (about 40px inset at 320px); the posture blockers list has a border but no padding.
requirements/TUTELA-SECURITY-RESULTS.md names classes that do not exist (ef-unknown-result, ef-exception-status, ef-evidence-chain, ef-boundary-map).
requirements/MARKETING-PRESENTATION.md mentions a hover lift that the CSS does not implement (the text looks stale).
